notablePrerequisites: Zur does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
description:
Declare Zur as an attacker.
Zur triggers, causing you to search your library for Stasis and put it onto the battlefield.
During the end step prior to your turn, activate Tel-Jilad Stylus by tapping it, putting Stasis on the bottom of your library from the battlefield.
Repeat.
